notes: "Agree on the scope before work begins. Different pages can be edited in parallel; a person can also hand a page from content drafting to visual refinement. This diagram illustrates a division between the project map and the Story tutorial, using actual page previews. Give shared project structure one owner, avoid simultaneous changes to the same page, and review every saved result at presentation size. Revision checks expose conflicts; they do not replace visual judgment. This English edition was authored by the main ChatGPT session."

designIntent.purpose: Assign page ownership, coordinate shared structure and inspect every result.
keep: Keep actual interface pixels, source attribution and the demonstrated behavior.
Keep stable page identity, editable objects and the correct author watermark.
designIntent.requestedChange: Teach an actionable Editor workflow through clear pictures and a focused narrative.
